key_idea: Turning a tile keeps the colors in the same order going around. Flipping is not allowed.
steps: Go around the tile to the right, starting at pink: pink, yellow, green, blue.
The left half of B is the tile just as it is: pink and yellow on top, blue and green below.
The right half of B is the tile turned upside down: green and blue on top, yellow and pink below.
Going around the right half, it is still pink, yellow, green, blue. So Nora can make B.

choice_feedback.A: Going around each half, the colors come in the wrong order. Nora would need to flip the tiles.
